title: Dungeon Forge
description:
Descend Into the DungeonChoose your class, prepare your gear, and head below the surface.

In Dungeon Forge, every run starts with a simple goal: gather what you can, become stronger, and see how deep you can go before the dungeon gets the better of you.

Choose Your ClassStart as one of several different classes, each built around a different playstyle.

Take the direct approach as a Warrior, rely on speed and Dexterity as a Rogue, use magic as a Mage, fight from range as a Ranger, or combine strength and support abilities as a Paladin.

Your starting stats shape how you approach combat and progression from the beginning of the run.

Explore the DepthsLeave the village behind and descend floor by floor into dark dungeon chambers.

Explore the map, search for resources, fight enemies, gain experience, and look for a way deeper underground. Keep track of your health, mana, equipment, resources, and everything you have collected along the way.

The farther you go, the more important preparation becomes.

Gather ResourcesNot everything you need comes from defeated enemies.

Chop trees for wood, mine stone and collect different ores that can be used for crafting and construction. Better tools allow you to gather resources more efficiently and prepare for tougher parts of the run.

What you bring back to the village can be just as important as what you find inside the dungeon.

Craft Better EquipmentUse collected materials to create improved tools, weapons, and armor.

Upgrade basic axes and pickaxes into stronger versions made from materials such as iron, copper, and mithril. Build a Forge to gain access to more advanced equipment and prepare yourself for deeper floors.

Choosing what to craft — and when to spend your limited resources — is part of every run.

Develop the VillageThe village is more than just a starting point.

Spend wood and stone to construct useful buildings such as a Sawmill, Forge, Kiln, and Trading Post. Each structure provides bonuses or new options that can make the rest of your run easier.

Invest in the village early, or save those materials for your equipment. The choice is yours.

Take On QuestsVisit the Quest Board for additional objectives while you explore.

Hunt specific enemies, collect requested materials, or complete other tasks to earn XP and valuable resources. Quests give you another reason to explore and can help speed up your character's progression.

Grow StrongerDefeat enemies, earn experience, level up, improve your equipment, and build around the strengths of your chosen class.

Every floor gives you another chance to improve — and another chance to lose everything.

Choose your class. Gather. Craft. Fight. Descend. Die. Repeat.
description_short: Choose your class and descend into Dungeon Forge. Fight monsters, gather wood, stone and ore, complete quests, craft better tools and gear, and build useful village structures. Grow stronger floor by floor, push deeper into the dungeon, and see how long your run can survive.
